verdict.rationale: Aider edits files, auto-commits changes, and can run tests or one-shot `--message` instructions. Nothing in the evidence shows it reading a tracked issue or opening a pull request. The community mentions of PRs (a user's own scripted pipeline) and of issues (a third party, Dosu, wanting to integrate Aider) are user-side workarounds or external tools, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
